dct_description_sm: This GIS dataset depicts the surficial geology of the Mikkwa River area (NTS 84G/NE) (discontinuous permafrost features). The data were created in geodatabase format and output for public distribution in shapefile format. These data comprise the permafrost polygon features of Alberta Geological Survey Map 576, Surficial Geology of the Mikkwa River Area (NTS 84G/NE).
dct_title_s: Surficial Geology of the Mikkwa River Area (NTS 84G/NE) (GIS data, permafrost polygon features)
